cross_boundary: Response finished in interval; exact native request reservation/submission time <18:33. Unknown request times remain separately counted, never silently excluded.
inclusion: Enumerate ALL final parent_queue/*.response.json files. Include every numeric finished_unix in [cut, through], independently of request existence, age, task metadata, or native consumption. No request-cohort prefilter.
native_consumption: Separately checked native observation/receipt; accepting a response or updating settings does not alone prove subsequent child generation or guidance use.
publication: Final response file visible at observation (not .partial); exact claim PUBLISHED hash joins reported independently. No request timestamp or PUBLISHED absence excludes an otherwise in-window response.
